name: workflow
description: A personal Codex plugin for explicit Git, ticket, and GitHub pull request workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Git, ticket, and pull request workflows
interface.longDescription: Prepare atomic Git changes, turn prepared work into tracker-ready tickets, or create a draft-by-default GitHub pull request with repository-aware templates, explicit publication boundaries, and marked visual evidence.
defaultPrompt: Review this Git change and propose an atomic branch and Conventional Commit.
Turn this prepared work into tracker-ready tickets.
Prepare the current branch as a reviewable GitHub pull request.
